methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $105M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
EarthGrid is a Seed-stage transportation company that has raised $105.3M to date. The transportation sector comp universe consists of 6 private peers—including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Navier, and Olympian Motors—with no public comparables identified. No public transportation companies trade at comparable scale or stage.

A Peer-Median triangulation method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage peers meeting valuation-tier filters; only three transportation companies exist in the broader peer set, and none satisfied the narrow screening criteria (minimum 3 datapoints required). Consequently, valuation relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using total raised ($105.3M) as a proxy base, this method implies a valuation of $263M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $224M to $303M, centered on $263M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the median implied by stage-progression mechanics. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set peer metrics to validate the 2.5x multiplier against actual market comps, and reliance on total raised as a valuation proxy rather than disclosed post-money valuations. Resolution of EarthGrid's path to Series A and capital intensity relative to transportation peers would refine this estimate.
